title: </sub>  Route human-only defects out of clean agreement
text:
</sub>  Route human-only defects out of clean agreement

When all compared reviewers report clean but human adjudication records a swept-category defect, this shortcut still marks the pull request terminal through `clean_agreement`, even though AC15(d) now puts that human-only defect in the denominator and treats both configurations as having missed it. The resulting record simultaneously says clean agreement and records a confirmed miss, corrupting both outcome counts and recall evidence. Require the clean shortcut to verify that no human-only defect was recorded, and define the human-only case as a terminal miss record.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/8a637efc47e64344f3f0fb6616cc2eab328da712/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
